acceptance: Per-engine 1_v7 rewrites merged and skips removed where green, or skip reasons updated to state rewrite-missing
context: Implemented on PR #2412, branch fix/tpchavoc-cloud-skip-sync, commit 5c20e9e3e. Added deterministic, lineitem-key-ordered native array rewrites for 1_v7: Snowflake ARRAY_AGG + TRANSFORM/REDUCE, BigQuery ARRAY_AGG + UNNEST/OFFSET, and Databricks ordered COLLECT_LIST + TRANSFORM/AGGREGATE/ZIP_WITH. Removed 1_v7 from all three cloud skip sets, registered query-adapter compatibility rules, updated validation mirrors and generated compatibility docs. Verification: Ruff passed; 10 focused tests passed; compat-docs and DDL drift checks passed. SQLGlot parsed all target dialects. A local full Spark execution probe was attempted but the installed JDK failed during SparkContext initialization before query analysis; no paid live-cloud execution was performed.
description: 1_v7 collects with list() then computes with list_sum/list_zip/list_transform, which exist only in DuckDB. Translation gets the collect half right per engine but leaves DuckDB-only compute functions. Needs three rewrites: Snowflake TRANSFORM+REDUCE, Databricks aggregate/transform/zip_with, BigQuery UNNEST+OFFSET. Each changes what the optimizer sees, partly defeating the variant purpose; until written the skip should be labeled rewrite-missing not unsupported.
